A member of the [[New Jedi Order]], this '''[[Human/Legends|Human]]''' fought in a battle and was badly injured. After the battle, the Jedi was found by [[Jedi healer/Legends|Chief Healer]] [[Cilghal]], who [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] him.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Jedi was created for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. Unnamed, he was placed on a card displaying [[Cilghal]]'s healing abilities.
